description: Which compose profiles each catalogue module needs on the pilot install. gremion-init-secrets renders COMPOSE_PROFILES=production,<the profiles of every pilot module> into state.env and both app-<colour>.env; gremion-services wire adds the postRealm profiles once the customer's realm exists. Profile names are stated here and nowhere else: the env templates keep COMPOSE_PROFILES=production. scripts/check-module-profiles.test.mjs pins this file against modules/*/module.json and the compose files.

board.reason: runs in-process on kernel tables and needs no compose profile (board-postgres is not started); it is selectable at create through the isolation gate since the board wave of 2026-11-11, and pilot stays false only because a pilot module here asks for at least one profile

calendar.reason: calendar-postgres (state) and calendar-service (app) share the profile; calendar runs as a leaf so the isolation evidence and the running path are the same code

content.reason: content-postgres (state) and content-service (app): the content tables exist only in the leaf database

elections.reason: off and invisible on the pilot; the Helios service is not part of this install

files.reason: in-process against Nextcloud (WebDAV with the user's own bearer); Collabora is its office editor

finance.reason: stays as it is: not part of this install and not part of its isolation evidence

handover.reason: no service of its own; not requested on the pilot

messaging.reason: video (livekit, element-call) needs no realm; messaging (messaging-postgres, matrix) is post-realm because Synapse refuses a blank issuer at boot, so gremion-services wire adds it. No new profile: the messaging module has runtime.database null, so a create with messaging ticked never connects to messaging-postgres

publishing.reason: newsletter-postgres (state) and newsletter-service (app): the newsletter has no backend but the leaf

vault.reason: stays as it is: not part of this install

votes.reason: in-process: the Polls client of the votes module talks to Nextcloud's Polls app
